subject: The 2 minute fix that saves 20
preview_text: Stop wasting time rewriting notes. Here's how to get meeting summaries in 2 minutes flat.
body_paragraphs: You know that sinking feeling when you leave a meeting and realize you forgot the one key action item? I've been there too many times. But here's the thing: you can fix it in 2 minutes, not 20.

Imagine this: you're in a rush, back-to-back calls, and you need to catch every detail. With Smart Notes, you just tap record, and 2 minutes later, you have a structured summary with key points and action items. No more scanning through hours of audio or scribbling notes that get lost.

That's our one-tap recording feature. It turns messy calls into clear, searchable transcripts and summaries. You focus on the conversation, we handle the cleanup. It's like having a teammate who never misses a thing.

Here's your move: Open the app, tap record on your next meeting, and see how it feels to walk away with clarity in 2 minutes. P.S. Users who try this once save an average of 3 hours a week. That's 3 hours you can spend on what actually matters.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes - AI Meeting Summary
